ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: According to a disclosure by the Anhui Provincial Cooperation and Exchange Office on July 6, 2012, affected by the downward pressure on economic operation, the growth rate of Anhui's use of investment from other provinces has declined somewhat, but it is still an outstanding performer nationwide in undertaking industrial transfer, and the number of major industrial projects introduced by the whole province has increased significantly. Read the following figure and answer the question. <image1> In which locational condition is another main reason that Anhui Province has become an outstanding performer nationwide in undertaking industrial transfer reflected?
ready1_open_rewrite.expected_answer: It is close to the developed areas of Shanghai, Jiangsu, and Zhejiang, making contact convenient
